column1: # Iliad - Part 1.5 — naskah 03 (M23003): rapat tempur di The Elmo sebelum Mokosh.
# Tetap Inggris: The Elmo, Groza, Alva, AK12, Koleda, Nele, DEFY, Paradeus, Pike Node,
# Nirvana, Lviv, URNC, Havier, Mangi Security, Mica Port, Connexion, Zoe, Lydia, Mokosh,
# Vasily, OTs-14, Sextans, Loreley, Statesec, Stasi, Dandelion, Cliffwatch, Winged Hussars,
# Liushih, Ullrid, Doll Community, Zucchero, Springfield, Voymastina, Klukai, Mayling,
# Helena, Melanie, Sinbreaker, Squad 404, Monsoon Squad, Cheyanne, Leafcutter Brigade,
# New Venice, Great Wall, Mr. White, M4, Frame, Doll, ELID, P.M.C., Kladenets, Heli,
# White Zone, Yellow Zone, Contamination Zone, Purification Project,
# 'P.M.C. Armed Firepower Act' (nama undang-undang = nama diri).
(On the desolate wilderness, the fierce wind swept up dark clouds.)
column2: (Di padang tandus itu, angin ganas menyapu awan kelam.)

column1: (The kicked-up dust and sand beat against the portholes of The Elmo, seemingly foretelling the coming storm along with the broadcast before my eyes—)
column2: (Debu dan pasir yang terangkat menghantam jendela bundar Elmo, seolah menubuatkan badai yang datang bersama siaran di depan mataku—)

column1: News Flash: Half an hour ago, the 'P.M.C. Armed Firepower Act' was officially passed by parliament.
column2: Berita Kilat: Setengah jam lalu, 'P.M.C. Armed Firepower Act' resmi disahkan parlemen.

column1: To further advance the Purification Project and maintain the stability of the lives of people in the Contamination Zones, state governments will further promote cooperation between the military, major corporations, and P.M.C.s to jointly crack down on illegal armed rebellions in the Contamination Zones...
column2: Guna mendorong Purification Project dan menjaga stabilitas kehidupan warga di Contamination Zone, pemerintah negara bagian akan makin memperluas kerja sama antara militer, korporasi besar, dan P.M.C. untuk bersama-sama menumpas pemberontakan bersenjata ilegal di Contamination Zone...

column1: (I expressionlessly pressed the switch, cutting off that loud broadcast.)
column2: (Tanpa ekspresi kutekan sakelarnya, memutus siaran berisik itu.)

column1: (Turning my head, I met Groza's eyes, which were filled with worry.)
column2: (Saat menoleh, mataku bertemu tatapan Groza yang penuh kecemasan.)

column1: Commander...
column2: Komandan...

column1: It's okay, Groza.
column2: Tidak apa-apa, Groza.

column1: After Alva finished the mission in New Venice, we already anticipated that all this would happen, didn't we?
column2: Setelah Alva menuntaskan misi di New Venice, kita sudah menduga semua ini akan terjadi, kan?

column1: (--A few days ago, Alva left alone on the pretext of supporting AK12's mission. After the mission ended, she didn't return, but sent a report instead.)
column2: (--Beberapa hari lalu, Alva pergi sendirian dengan dalih mendukung misi AK12. Setelah misi selesai, dia tidak kembali, melainkan mengirim laporan.)

column1: (The report not only thoroughly reviewed everything that happened in New Venice, but also mentioned that she had gone to Nele's side for Frame repairs.)
column2: (Laporan itu tak hanya mengulas tuntas semua yang terjadi di New Venice, tapi juga menyebut bahwa dia pergi ke tempat Nele untuk perbaikan Frame.)

column1: (And AK12, who escaped safely—perhaps she should be called Koleda now—stated that she still had unresolved matters and would not return to The Elmo for the time being.)
column2: (Dan AK12 yang berhasil lolos—mungkin sekarang harus dipanggil Koleda—menyatakan masih ada urusan yang belum selesai dan belum akan kembali ke Elmo.)

column1: (I picked up the tablet on the table again. This report is very much in Alva's style; she sorted out all the events that happened in New Venice from the beginning according to the timeline.)
column2: (Kuambil lagi tablet di meja. Laporan ini benar-benar khas Alva; dia menyusun semua peristiwa di New Venice dari awal sesuai urutan waktu.)

column1: (And specifically marked the three most important and urgent things:)
column2: (Dan secara khusus menandai tiga hal paling penting dan mendesak:)

column1: (First thing: Combined with the act just reported in the news, the Financial Conglomerate should indeed have grasped part of Heli's authority, and also developed a more targeted virus based on this—Kladenets.)
column2: (Hal pertama: Dikaitkan dengan undang-undang yang baru diberitakan tadi, Financial Conglomerate memang tampaknya sudah menguasai sebagian otoritas Heli, dan dari situ mengembangkan virus yang lebih tertarget—Kladenets.)

column1: (Alva also specifically annotated that this word might come from the "God-slaying Sword" in Slavic mythology. And in today's electronic field, the existence that the Financial Conglomerate still cannot surpass is...)
column2: (Alva juga secara khusus mencatat bahwa kata itu mungkin berasal dari "Pedang Pembunuh Dewa" dalam mitologi Slavia. Dan di ranah elektronik masa kini, sosok yang masih tak bisa dilampaui Financial Conglomerate adalah...)

column1: (Thinking this, I subconsciously called out that familiar name—)
column2: (Sambil berpikir begitu, tanpa sadar kupanggil nama yang akrab itu—)

column1: Dandelion, do you have any intel on your end that you can share?
column2: Dandelion, ada informasi dari sisimu yang bisa dibagi?

column1: (Silence.)
column2: (Hening.)

column1: (No one answered in the command room, only the communication screen emitted a sizzling static sound.)
column2: (Tak ada yang menjawab di ruang komando, hanya layar komunikasi yang mendesis penuh statis.)

column1: Dandelion? Are you there?
column2: Dandelion? Kau di sana?

column1: (Still a completely unresponsive silence.)
column2: (Masih hening tanpa respons sama sekali.)

column1: (Dandelion's absense, combined with the report I just saw, gave me a slight bad premonition.)
column2: (Absennya Dandelion, ditambah laporan yang baru kubaca, memberiku firasat buruk yang samar.)

column1: ...Groza, does Dandelion lose contact often?
column2: ...Groza, apa Dandelion sering hilang kontak?

column1: You mean situations where we can't reach Dandelion?
column2: Maksud Anda saat kita tidak bisa menghubungi Dandelion?

column1: Let me see... it happens roughly once a week.
column2: Sebentar... kira-kira seminggu sekali.

column1: —So it happens weekly?
column2: —Jadi tiap minggu?

column1: Yes, it's just that every time you encounter a problem, she "happens" to be there.
column2: Ya, cuma saja tiap kali Anda menghadapi masalah, dia "kebetulan" selalu ada.

column1: Even Mayling has trouble getting ahold of her. The last time we couldn't contact her, the reason she gave was:
column2: Mayling saja susah menghubunginya. Terakhir kali kami tak bisa menghubunginya, alasan yang dia berikan:

column1: 'I went to help a friend sign up for a fitness class.'
column2: 'Aku pergi membantu teman mendaftar kelas kebugaran.'

column1: ...Then it seems I worried for nothing. With Dandelion's strength, the one who should be having a headache is the Financial Conglomerate.
column2: ...Kalau begitu sepertinya aku cemas sia-sia. Dengan kekuatan Dandelion, yang seharusnya pusing itu Financial Conglomerate.

column1: (I temporarily put aside my worries about Dandelion and continued to look at the second point of attention on the report.)
column2: (Kutepikan dulu kecemasanku soal Dandelion dan lanjut membaca poin kedua di laporan itu.)

column1: (Second point: The Financial Conglomerate holds some kind of machine that can attract ELID on a large scale. In order to achieve the political goal of advancing the armed act, they personally directed this New Venice massacre.)
column2: (Poin kedua: Financial Conglomerate memegang semacam mesin yang bisa menarik ELID dalam skala besar. Demi tujuan politik meloloskan undang-undang persenjataan itu, merekalah dalang langsung pembantaian New Venice ini.)

column1: (In this, the military—or at least the force called the Leafcutter Brigade—played the role of an accomplice in the massacre.)
column2: (Dalam hal ini, militer—atau setidaknya pasukan bernama Leafcutter Brigade—berperan sebagai kaki tangan pembantaian itu.)

column1: (Thinking of this, the hand I used to pinch the edge of the tablet couldn't help but increase its force a bit.)
column2: (Memikirkan itu, tanganku yang menjepit tepi tablet tanpa sadar mengeras.)

column1: (The afterimage of the city completely swallowed by artillery fire and smoke ten years ago once again uncontrollably crashed into my mind. That suffocating smell of sulfur, and the helpless cries for help in the raging fire, seemed to linger in my ears.)
column2: (Bayangan kota yang sepenuhnya ditelan tembakan artileri dan asap sepuluh tahun lalu kembali menghantam pikiranku tanpa bisa kucegah. Bau belerang yang menyesakkan itu, dan jerit minta tolong yang tak berdaya di tengah kobaran api, seakan masih menggantung di telingaku.)

column1: Commander... are you okay?
column2: Komandan... Anda tidak apa-apa?

column1: Mhm... I'm fine, Groza. I just remembered some things from the past.
column2: Mhm... aku tidak apa-apa, Groza. Cuma teringat beberapa hal masa lalu.

column1: (I placed the tablet face down on the desk and tiredly rubbed my temples, forcefully pulling myself out of my memories of the past.)
column2: (Kutelungkupkan tablet itu di meja dan kupijat pelipisku dengan lelah, memaksa diriku keluar dari kenangan masa lalu.)

column1: (Because the third item mentioned in the report... is, at this very moment, stored right here aboard The Elmo.)
column2: (Sebab hal ketiga yang disebut dalam laporan itu... saat ini justru tersimpan di sini, di dalam Elmo.)

column1: (Accompanied by the soft click of the Command Room's hatch opening, Voymastina walked in briskly.)
column2: (Diiringi klik pelan pintu ruang komando yang terbuka, Voymastina melangkah masuk dengan cekatan.)

column1: Is everything sorted out?
column2: Semuanya sudah beres?

column1: Mhm, Commander. We've completely scrubbed all traceable evidence as requested.
column2: Mhm, Komandan. Semua bukti yang bisa dilacak sudah kami hapus tuntas sesuai permintaan.

column1: Currently, Mayling is conducting the final shielding check on the 'Pike Node'.
column2: Saat ini Mayling sedang melakukan pemeriksaan perisai terakhir pada 'Pike Node'.

column1: Good work, Voymastina.
column2: Kerja bagus, Voymastina.

column1: (Although Alva and Koleda didn't completely prevent the tragedy from happening in New Venice, they forcefully snatched away the most important trophy from the conglomerate's layout.)
column2: (Meski Alva dan Koleda tidak sepenuhnya mencegah tragedi di New Venice, mereka berhasil merebut paksa piala terpenting dari rencana konglomerat itu.)

column1: (That is the key to prying into the Nirvana space, and also the core device that caused drastic changes in Lviv—the [Pike Node].)
column2: (Itulah kunci untuk mengintip ruang Nirvana, sekaligus perangkat inti yang memicu perubahan drastis di Lviv—[Pike Node].)

column1: (This is exactly the third item in the report, and also the most substantial piece of intelligence for me at present.)
column2: (Inilah persis hal ketiga dalam laporan itu, sekaligus informasi paling nyata bagiku saat ini.)

column1: (Alva detailed in the report all the intelligence DEFY had grasped regarding the Pike Node.)
column2: (Alva merinci dalam laporannya seluruh informasi yang dikuasai DEFY mengenai Pike Node.)

column1: (I know very well just how important this thing is to the conglomerate... especially to the long-lurking Paradeus.)
column2: (Aku tahu betul betapa pentingnya benda ini bagi konglomerat... terutama bagi Paradeus yang lama bersembunyi.)

column1: Commander... keeping such a thing on The Elmo, will it make you the target of all factions again?
column2: Komandan... menyimpan benda seperti itu di Elmo, tidakkah itu akan menjadikan Anda incaran semua faksi lagi?

column1: At that time in Lviv, the Pike Node was recovered by the URNC government, right?
column2: Waktu di Lviv dulu, Pike Node diamankan pemerintah URNC, kan?

column1: Yes... it was Havier who executed the recovery. Are you saying—?
column2: Ya... Havier yang melaksanakan pengamanannya. Maksudmu—?

column1: (I calmly shook my head.)
column2: (Kugelengkan kepala dengan tenang.)

column1: I know Havier, he wouldn't do such a thing.
column2: Aku kenal Havier, dia tidak akan berbuat begitu.

column1: But... the URNC government is a mixed bag, just like this New Venice massacre.
column2: Tapi... pemerintah URNC itu campur aduk isinya, sama seperti pembantaian New Venice ini.

column1: (If it weren't for Alva's efforts in New Venice, I wouldn't have been able to discover the truth from public information like "Great Wall defenders neglected their duties and allowed ELID to invade the new city" and "Mangi Security elite troops turned the tide and rescued the people", nor would I have been able to connect the P.M.C. armed firepower act being promoted with the Financial Conglomerate's plan.)
column2: (Kalau bukan karena kerja keras Alva di New Venice, aku tidak akan bisa menemukan kebenarannya dari informasi publik semacam "penjaga Great Wall lalai bertugas sehingga ELID menyerbu kota baru" dan "pasukan elite Mangi Security membalikkan keadaan dan menyelamatkan warga", dan tidak akan bisa mengaitkan undang-undang persenjataan P.M.C. yang sedang digalakkan itu dengan rencana Financial Conglomerate.)

column1: (Now, the act has officially passed. This also means that the Financial Conglomerate can conduct military activities in the Yellow Zone without any hindrance, and those towns that broke free from the Financial Conglomerate's control not long ago will probably soon face the situation of an army at their gates.)
column2: (Kini undang-undang itu resmi disahkan. Artinya Financial Conglomerate bisa menggelar kegiatan militer di Yellow Zone tanpa hambatan, dan kota-kota yang belum lama ini lepas dari kendali mereka mungkin akan segera menghadapi pasukan di depan gerbang.)

column1: (We have long been in the center of the vortex. Having an extra trump card in hand is always better than waiting to be slaughtered.)
column2: (Kita sudah lama berada di pusat pusaran. Memegang satu kartu truf tambahan selalu lebih baik daripada menunggu disembelih.)

column1: I know your worries, Groza. I also know how sinister the future situation will be.
column2: Aku paham kecemasanmu, Groza. Aku juga tahu betapa kelamnya situasi ke depan.

column1: But because of Alva's reminder, we have already started preparing for battle in advance.
column2: Tapi berkat peringatan Alva, kita sudah mulai bersiap tempur lebih awal.

column1: The Doll reconnaissance squad has been dispatched, and the combat preparation work of the Doll Community and The Elmo is also proceeding in an orderly manner. As for Mokosh—they have been preparing for this battle for a long time.
column2: Regu pengintai Doll sudah dikerahkan, dan persiapan tempur Doll Community serta Elmo juga berjalan tertib. Soal Mokosh—mereka sudah lama bersiap untuk pertempuran ini.

column1: The Commander is always optimistic like this, no matter the time.
column2: Komandan memang selalu optimis begini, kapan pun itu.

column1: Then, the current plan is—
column2: Kalau begitu, rencana kita sekarang—

column1: (BEEP—)
column2: (BIP—)

column1: (An urgent comms notification interrupted Groza.)
column2: (Notifikasi komunikasi darurat memotong ucapan Groza.)

column1: Commander, it's an emergency transmission from Mica Port.
column2: Komandan, ini transmisi darurat dari Mica Port.

column1: Answer it.
column2: Sambungkan.

column1: Commander, it's the conglomerate! Those guys from the conglomerate are here again!
column2: Komandan, konglomerat! Orang-orang konglomerat itu datang lagi!

column1: Wait, let, let me go!
column2: Tunggu, le-lepaskan aku!

column1: (As soon as the communication connected, Zoe's anxious shouts came through.)
column2: (Begitu komunikasi tersambung, teriakan panik Zoe langsung terdengar.)

column1: (But immediately after, a commotion could be heard from the other end of the line.)
column2: (Tapi tak lama kemudian, terdengar keributan dari ujung sana.)

column1: Zoe? Zoe! Are you okay?
column2: Zoe? Zoe! Kau tidak apa-apa?

column1: (A moment of silence.)
column2: (Hening sejenak.)

column1: Commander, someone else is answering now.
column2: Komandan, sekarang orang lain yang menjawab.

column1: Theoretically speaking, we shouldn't have contact with you. No one knows if the current channel is being monitored.
column2: Secara teori, kami tidak boleh berhubungan dengan Anda. Tak ada yang tahu apakah kanal ini sedang disadap.

column1: (Zoe's roar seemed to come from the background noise, indicating that the channel she used wouldn't be monitored — or so it sounds...)
column2: (Raungan Zoe terdengar dari kebisingan latar, menandakan bahwa kanal yang dia pakai tidak akan disadap — begitu kedengarannya...)

column1: An hour ago, several transport vehicles marked "Mangi Security" drove into Mica Port.
column2: Satu jam lalu, beberapa kendaraan angkut berlogo "Mangi Security" masuk ke Mica Port.

column1: They directly brought people into Connexion, saying that both Mica Port and Connexion have been taken over by the Financial Conglomerate.
column2: Mereka langsung membawa orang masuk ke Connexion, menyatakan Mica Port dan Connexion sudah diambil alih Financial Conglomerate.

column1: What about you guys? Where is Zoe right now?
column2: Bagaimana dengan kalian? Zoe sekarang di mana?

column1: She is very safe. As for the location, I think I don't need to tell you.
column2: Dia sangat aman. Soal lokasinya, kurasa tidak perlu kuberitahukan.

column1: (The act was just passed, yet the conglomerate has already taken action. It seems that Mangi Security's stationing at Mica Port is not just an independent operation, but the very beginning of a series of premeditated counterattacks by the conglomerate.)
column2: (Undang-undangnya baru saja disahkan, tapi konglomerat sudah bergerak. Sepertinya penempatan Mangi Security di Mica Port bukan operasi tunggal, melainkan awal dari rangkaian serangan balik yang sudah direncanakan matang.)

column1: (Although Mica Port overall possesses a certain amount of strength, in terms of military might, going up against Mangi Security is definitely like a mantis trying to stop a chariot.)
column2: (Meski secara keseluruhan Mica Port punya kekuatan tertentu, dari sisi militer, melawan Mangi Security jelas seperti belalang sembah menghadang kereta perang.)

column1: Lydia, the situation Mica Port is facing right now is no longer something you can handle.
column2: Lydia, situasi yang dihadapi Mica Port sekarang sudah bukan sesuatu yang bisa kalian tangani.

column1: The Elmo will find a way to support you, but we need to wait for the right opportunity.
column2: Elmo akan mencari cara untuk membantu kalian, tapi kami perlu menunggu momen yang tepat.

column1: Support us?
column2: Membantu kami?

column1: No, Commander, if Zoe hadn't taken the liberty of contacting you, I wouldn't have even contacted you at all.
column2: Tidak, Komandan, kalau Zoe tidak lancang menghubungi Anda, aku sama sekali tidak akan menghubungi Anda.

column1: The enemy's military strength has already exceeded the forces a P.M.C. can mobilize, which is why Mica Port was surrendered to them without any resistance.
column2: Kekuatan militer musuh sudah melampaui pasukan yang bisa dikerahkan sebuah P.M.C., itulah kenapa Mica Port diserahkan tanpa perlawanan.

column1: But their target won't just be Mica Port.
column2: Tapi target mereka tidak akan berhenti di Mica Port.

column1: In the Yellow Zone, where exactly is worth them mobilizing such forces? I shouldn't need to say more, right?
column2: Di Yellow Zone, tempat mana lagi yang sepadan dengan pengerahan pasukan sebesar itu? Rasanya tidak perlu kujelaskan, kan?

column1: Before the storm ends, we won't contact The Elmo for the time being, and I've confiscated Zoe's equipment for now.
column2: Sampai badai ini reda, kami tidak akan menghubungi Elmo, dan perangkat Zoe sudah kusita untuk sementara.

column1: We'll figure out a way to solve the matters at Mica Port ourselves later. Good luck, Commander.
column2: Urusan Mica Port akan kami cari jalan keluarnya sendiri nanti. Semoga berhasil, Komandan.

column1: I understand... the information from this communication is already of great value.
column2: Aku mengerti... informasi dari komunikasi ini saja sudah sangat berharga.

column1: Thank you and Zoe. If you have any difficulties, contact The Elmo anytime.
column2: Terima kasih untukmu dan Zoe. Kalau kalian kesulitan, hubungi Elmo kapan saja.

column1: (Hanging up the communication, I turned to Groza.)
column2: (Setelah menutup komunikasi, aku berpaling ke Groza.)

column1: Since the Financial Conglomerate has already stationed in Mica Port, I'm afraid they will soon march into Mokosh.
column2: Karena Financial Conglomerate sudah bercokol di Mica Port, kurasa mereka akan segera bergerak ke Mokosh.

column1: Contact Mokosh right now, and tell him that our meeting is moved up, we're going today.
column2: Hubungi Mokosh sekarang juga, sampaikan pertemuannya dimajukan, kita berangkat hari ini.

column1: Moved up to today?
column2: Dimajukan jadi hari ini?

column1: (Groza showed a bit of hesitation.)
column2: (Groza tampak sedikit ragu.)

column1: Three hours ago, Vasily sent Mokosh's second-phase defense plan, as well as a new list of combat preparation materials.
column2: Tiga jam lalu, Vasily mengirim rencana pertahanan fase kedua Mokosh, beserta daftar baru material persiapan tempur.

column1: This batch of supplies was originally scheduled to be delivered during the meeting the day after tomorrow. Everyone is still preparing now. If the meeting is moved up, I'm afraid there won't be enough time to send them all together.
column2: Kiriman pasokan itu semula dijadwalkan tiba saat pertemuan lusa. Semua orang masih menyiapkannya. Kalau pertemuannya dimajukan, saya khawatir tidak sempat mengirim semuanya sekaligus.

column1: Send as much as you can. If we go late, I'm afraid even entering the city will be a problem.
column2: Kirim sebanyak yang bisa. Kalau kita terlambat, masuk kotanya saja mungkin sudah jadi masalah.

column1: Yes. Then, I will first summarize the current intelligence for Vasily.
column2: Baik. Kalau begitu, saya akan merangkum informasi terkini untuk Vasily lebih dulu.

column1: Hehe, the Commander's judgment is very accurate.
column2: Hehe, penilaian Komandan tepat sekali.

column1: (With a soft chuckle, OTs-14 quickly walks into the command room.)
column2: (Sambil terkekeh pelan, OTs-14 masuk cepat ke ruang komando.)

column1: (- Not long ago, in order to cope with the impending intensified battles, I had OTs-14 and Sextans form a brand new squad of third-generation Dolls.)
column2: (- Belum lama ini, demi menghadapi pertempuran yang bakal makin sengit, kuminta OTs-14 dan Sextans membentuk regu Doll generasi ketiga yang benar-benar baru.)

column1: (Initially, OTs-14 was rather dissatisfied with being transferred from adjutant duties to join a new squad.)
column2: (Awalnya, OTs-14 cukup keberatan dipindah dari tugas ajudan ke regu baru.)

column1: (However, after conducting actual combat drills with the original squad members and Sextans respectively, and my promise that she could still rotate as adjutant with Groza, she still accepted this new 'Captain' job.)
column2: (Tapi setelah menjalani latihan tempur nyata bersama anggota regu lama dan Sextans, serta janjiku bahwa dia tetap bisa bergiliran jadi ajudan dengan Groza, akhirnya dia menerima juga pekerjaan 'Kapten' yang baru ini.)

column1: (At this moment, OTs-14 walked briskly in front of me and showed me the footage she had just scouted.)
column2: (Saat ini, OTs-14 melangkah cepat ke hadapanku dan menunjukkan rekaman hasil pengintaiannya barusan.)

column1: Sextans and I found some interesting intelligence during our patrol mission just now.
column2: Sextans dan saya menemukan informasi menarik saat misi patroli tadi.

column1: Around Mokosh... no, including the surroundings of neighboring settlements, traces of large numbers of troops marching have appeared.
column2: Di sekitar Mokosh... bukan, termasuk sekitar permukiman tetangga, muncul jejak pergerakan pasukan dalam jumlah besar.

column1: Those troops are not only from Mangi Security, but also from other P.M.C.s hired by the conglomerate, and their equipment is even more sophisticated than before.
column2: Pasukan itu bukan cuma dari Mangi Security, tapi juga P.M.C. lain yang disewa konglomerat, dan perlengkapan mereka lebih canggih dari sebelumnya.

column1: Sextans is still monitoring their subsequent whereabouts, but Commander, you need to make a decision on how to respond next.
column2: Sextans masih memantau pergerakan lanjutan mereka, tapi Komandan, Anda perlu memutuskan langkah kita berikutnya.

column1: For Mokosh, I'm afraid... this will be a difficult battle.
column2: Bagi Mokosh, saya khawatir... ini akan jadi pertempuran yang berat.

column1: (OTs-14 showed a rare serious expression. Looking at her, I could roughly imagine how thorny things would be later.)
column2: (OTs-14 menunjukkan ekspresi serius yang jarang terlihat. Melihatnya, aku bisa membayangkan betapa berdurinya keadaan nanti.)

column1: (But to protect this precious spark, no matter how thorny it gets, I cannot back down.)
column2: (Tapi demi melindungi percikan berharga ini, sebanyak apa pun durinya, aku tidak boleh mundur.)

column1: Alright, I have a general understanding.
column2: Baik, aku sudah dapat gambaran umumnya.

column1: The situation is very grim, but you definitely don't want to hear me say discouraging words, right?
column2: Situasinya sangat suram, tapi kalian pasti tidak mau mendengarku bicara hal yang melemahkan semangat, kan?

column1: Groza, OTs-14, now, assemble all squads, we will hold a combat meeting.
column2: Groza, OTs-14, sekarang, kumpulkan semua regu, kita akan menggelar rapat tempur.

column1: (Soon, the captains of each squad assembled in the command room, and the squads out scouting were also on standby in the communication channel.)
column2: (Tak lama, para kapten tiap regu berkumpul di ruang komando, dan regu yang sedang mengintai pun siaga di kanal komunikasi.)

column1: (Looking around at the assembled Dolls, I slowly spoke.)
column2: (Sambil menyapu pandangan ke para Doll yang berkumpul, aku mulai bicara perlahan.)

column1: Everyone, after the P.M.C. firepower armament was released, the conglomerate has launched a full-scale counteroffensive against the Yellow Zone settlements.
column2: Semuanya, setelah persenjataan P.M.C. dilepas, konglomerat melancarkan serangan balik besar-besaran terhadap permukiman Yellow Zone.

column1: Half an hour ago, the conglomerate's forces stationed at Mica Port. According to our reconnaissance, the same flames of war will soon spread to Mokosh.
column2: Setengah jam lalu, pasukan konglomerat bercokol di Mica Port. Menurut pengintaian kita, kobaran perang yang sama akan segera merembet ke Mokosh.

column1: Not just that~ Commander.
column2: Bukan cuma itu~ Komandan.

column1: (A charming voice suddenly chimed in.)
column2: (Sebuah suara memikat tiba-tiba menyela.)

column1: Loreley? When did you...
column2: Loreley? Sejak kapan kau...

column1: Hehe~ Am I not welcome? Since it concerns Mokosh, as the representative of Statesec, I naturally ought to attend.
column2: Hehe~ Aku tidak diterima? Karena ini menyangkut Mokosh, sebagai perwakilan Statesec sudah sewajarnya aku hadir.

column1: (Loreley slowly revealed a smile.)
column2: (Loreley perlahan menyunggingkan senyum.)

column1: A few hours ago, a White Zone government building strictly guarded and locked down by Stasi agents experienced some abnormal commotion, and it seems a fierce armed conflict occurred.
column2: Beberapa jam lalu, sebuah gedung pemerintahan White Zone yang dijaga ketat dan dikunci agen Stasi mengalami kegaduhan tak wajar, dan sepertinya terjadi konflik bersenjata yang sengit.

column1: —! It's Dandelion? I knew it...
column2: —! Dandelion? Sudah kuduga...

column1: Mhm~ However, it seems someone witnessed an unknown dark shadow crashing through a window and falling, so you don't need to worry too much. It's just that in the short term, the other party probably won't be able to contact you.
column2: Mhm~ Tapi ada yang melihat bayangan gelap tak dikenal menembus jendela dan terjun keluar, jadi kau tidak perlu terlalu cemas. Hanya saja dalam waktu dekat, orang itu mungkin belum bisa menghubungimu.

column1: ...Alright. This is indeed very useful intelligence, thank you, Loreley.
column2: ...Baiklah. Ini memang informasi yang sangat berguna, terima kasih, Loreley.

column1: You're welcome~ Then, I won't continue to disturb the internal combat meeting~ If you need Statesec's support in the future, please contact me anytime.
column2: Sama-sama~ Kalau begitu, aku tidak akan mengganggu rapat tempur internal kalian lagi~ Kalau nanti butuh dukungan Statesec, hubungi aku kapan saja.

column1: I... will be very happy to provide you with help.
column2: Aku... akan dengan senang hati membantumu.

column1: (As her voice fell, Loreley's figure disappeared from sight.)
column2: (Begitu suaranya mereda, sosok Loreley lenyap dari pandangan.)

column1: (But I was still digesting the stormy waves brought on by this intelligence—)
column2: (Tapi aku masih mencerna gelombang badai yang dibawa informasi itu—)

column1: (What is Stasi's intention in suddenly moving against Dandelion at a time like this? Although I have absolute confidence in Dandelion's abilities, does she need my help? And being far away in the Yellow Zone, how can I offer her any help?)
column2: (Apa maksud Stasi tiba-tiba bergerak melawan Dandelion di saat seperti ini? Meski aku sepenuhnya percaya pada kemampuan Dandelion, apa dia butuh bantuanku? Dan dari Yellow Zone yang sejauh ini, bantuan apa yang bisa kuberikan?)

column1: All squads, attention—
column2: Seluruh regu, perhatian—

column1: (I pulled up the tactical sand table, looking around at the pairs of eyes.)
column2: (Kubuka meja pasir taktis, menyapu pandangan ke sepasang-sepasang mata itu.)

column1: Next, our most important mission is to guard Mokosh.
column2: Berikutnya, misi terpenting kita adalah menjaga Mokosh.

column1: OTs-14 and Sextans, you will sort out immediately as the vanguard.
column2: OTs-14 dan Sextans, kalian segera bersiap sebagai pasukan garis depan.

column1: OTs-14, after assisting with the supply transport mission is complete, I will leave the remaining Dolls of The Elmo's composite formation under your command to provide mobile support to the external battlefield.
column2: OTs-14, setelah misi pengawalan pasokan selesai, sisa Doll dari formasi gabungan Elmo kuserahkan ke komandomu untuk memberi dukungan bergerak ke medan luar.

column1: Orders received. Rest assured and leave it to me, Commander.
column2: Perintah diterima. Tenang saja dan serahkan pada saya, Komandan.

column1: Squad 404, Cheyanne, you are familiar with Mokosh's battlefield environment. Infiltrate with me and internally support Mokosh alongside Monsoon Squad and Squad 404's 2nd Team stationed there.
column2: Squad 404, Cheyanne, kalian paham medan Mokosh. Menyusup bersamaku dan dukung Mokosh dari dalam bersama Monsoon Squad dan Tim 2 Squad 404 yang bertugas di sana.

column1: Commander...!
column2: Komandan...!

column1: Vasily has no real combat command experience. I must go to Mokosh and fight with them.
column2: Vasily tidak punya pengalaman memimpin pertempuran nyata. Aku harus ke Mokosh dan bertempur bersama mereka.

column1: Understood. The Commander's safety is left to Squad 404.
column2: Dimengerti. Keselamatan Komandan diserahkan pada Squad 404.

column1: Liushih, the Winged Hussars have strong mobile combat capabilities. While guarding Cliffwatch, I need your formation to stand by on mobile alert around Mokosh, maintaining external response.
column2: Liushih, Winged Hussars punya kemampuan tempur bergerak yang kuat. Sambil menjaga Cliffwatch, aku butuh formasimu siaga bergerak di sekitar Mokosh, menjaga respons dari luar.

column1: Yes! The defense of Cliffwatch has long been arranged. The Winged Hussars can respond to support at any time. Call us to your heart's content when you need us, Commander!
column2: Siap! Pertahanan Cliffwatch sudah lama diatur. Winged Hussars bisa merespons bantuan kapan saja. Panggil kami sepuasnya kalau Anda butuh, Komandan!

column1: Ullrid, continue to lead everyone to guard the Doll Community well. You are the Dolls' last line of defense.
column2: Ullrid, terus pimpin semuanya menjaga Doll Community baik-baik. Kalian garis pertahanan terakhir para Doll.

column1: Of course! The Doll Community is our home, and also your final backup.
column2: Tentu saja! Doll Community adalah rumah kami, sekaligus cadangan terakhir Anda.

column1: Mhm. The external support missions are arranged up to here. Finally, there is one most important mission.
column2: Mhm. Misi dukungan eksternal diatur sampai di sini. Terakhir, ada satu misi yang paling penting.

column1: (I turned to the long-waiting Groza and Springfield.)
column2: (Aku berpaling ke Groza dan Springfield yang sedari tadi menunggu.)

column1: Groza, Zucchero Squad, station on The Elmo together with the comprehensive echelon. You must guard Mayling, Helena, and Melanie well. And—
column2: Groza, Zucchero Squad, bertahan di Elmo bersama eselon gabungan. Kalian harus menjaga Mayling, Helena, dan Melanie baik-baik. Dan—

column1: (I glanced at Voymastina.)
column2: (Kulirik Voymastina.)

column1: Together with Voymastina, guard the 'Pike Node' well.
column2: Bersama Voymastina, jaga 'Pike Node' baik-baik.

column1: Pike Node? Such a thing is actually on The Elmo?
column2: Pike Node? Benda seperti itu ternyata ada di Elmo?

column1: ...Do you know what this is?
column2: ...Kau tahu ini apa?

column1: I'm not entirely clear on the specifics, but the Pike Node...
column2: Saya tidak paham detailnya, tapi Pike Node...

column1: It should be one of the core items that triggered the Lviv incident, right?
column2: Seharusnya itu salah satu benda inti yang memicu insiden Lviv, kan?

column1: (All the Dolls looked at Voymastina together, seeking verification of Springfield's statement.)
column2: (Semua Doll serempak menoleh ke Voymastina, meminta konfirmasi atas ucapan Springfield.)

column1: Yes.
column2: Ya.

column1: (The conversation ended just like that.)
column2: (Percakapannya berakhir begitu saja.)

column1: (Silence fell over the scene.)
column2: (Keheningan menyelimuti ruangan.)

column1: ...How about you say a few more words, then?
column2: ...Bagaimana kalau kau bicara sedikit lebih banyak?

column1: It's not like all Dolls are like you DEFY members, going wherever you please.
column2: Tidak semua Doll seperti kalian anggota DEFY yang bisa pergi sesuka hati.

column1: This is indeed the key item that caused the Lviv incident.
column2: Ini memang benda kunci yang menyebabkan insiden Lviv.

column1: I don't understand the specific principles either. It's currently just temporarily stored on The Elmo. This is Koleda...
column2: Saya juga tidak paham prinsip detailnya. Saat ini benda itu hanya dititipkan sementara di Elmo. Ini keputusan Koleda...

column1: (Voymastina rarely paused while speaking.)
column2: (Voymastina jarang sekali terhenti saat bicara.)

column1: No, it's the decision of Defy's captain 'Alva'. After all, Defy has no ally more trustworthy than the Commander.
column2: Bukan, ini keputusan kapten Defy, 'Alva'. Lagi pula, Defy tidak punya sekutu yang lebih bisa dipercaya daripada Komandan.

column1: Tch... You all went and brought another troublesome thing onboard...
column2: Cih... Kalian membawa satu lagi barang merepotkan ke atas kapal...

column1: It's 'we', right, Miss Klukai?
column2: 'Kita', kan, Nona Klukai?

column1: Regarding the "Pike Node", everyone doesn't need to worry too much.
column2: Soal "Pike Node", kalian tidak perlu terlalu cemas.

column1: Koleda thought of some ways to indirectly deliver the "Pike Node" to The Elmo. Currently, the "Pike Node" is an absolute secret on The Elmo.
column2: Koleda memikirkan beberapa cara untuk mengantar "Pike Node" ke Elmo secara tidak langsung. Saat ini, "Pike Node" adalah rahasia mutlak di Elmo.

column1: Even if a war really starts, as long as I'm not on The Elmo, the other party has no reason to make The Elmo the primary strike target.
column2: Bahkan kalau perang benar-benar pecah, selama aku tidak ada di Elmo, pihak lawan tidak punya alasan menjadikan Elmo target serangan utama.

column1: However, considering the combat power of Voymastina and Sinbreaker, when Mokosh encounters an emergency, they may be dispatched as support at any time.
column2: Namun, mengingat daya tempur Voymastina dan Sinbreaker, kalau Mokosh menghadapi keadaan darurat, mereka bisa dikirim sebagai bantuan kapan saja.

column1: So, Groza, Springfield, you must protect The Elmo well, and absolutely cannot let the conglomerate discover the traces of the Pike.
column2: Jadi, Groza, Springfield, kalian harus melindungi Elmo baik-baik, dan sama sekali tidak boleh membiarkan konglomerat menemukan jejak Pike.

column1: ...I don't know when Dandelion will come online again. For now, I leave everything on The Elmo to you.
column2: ...Aku tidak tahu kapan Dandelion akan aktif lagi. Untuk sekarang, semua di Elmo kuserahkan pada kalian.

column1: Yes. Zucchero Café will respond with full force.
column2: Siap. Zucchero Café akan merespons dengan segenap tenaga.

column1: I understand, but—
column2: Saya mengerti, tapi—

column1: I will take good care of myself.
column2: Aku akan menjaga diriku baik-baik.

column1: ...Yes. I will guard The Elmo well.
column2: ...Baik. Saya akan menjaga Elmo dengan baik.

column1: (Groza frowned, but still seriously agreed to me.)
column2: (Groza mengerutkan kening, tapi tetap menyanggupi dengan serius.)

column1: (After confirming that Groza had fully understood my request, I turned to Mayling.)
column2: (Setelah memastikan Groza benar-benar paham permintaanku, aku berpaling ke Mayling.)

column1: Mayling... just a well-intentioned suggestion. Before the war officially starts, do you want to go over to Mr. White's side?
column2: Mayling... ini cuma saran dengan niat baik. Sebelum perang resmi dimulai, maukah kau pindah ke tempat Mr. White?

column1: He contacted me a while ago and discussed matters regarding Mokosh. If you—
column2: Dia menghubungiku beberapa waktu lalu dan membahas soal Mokosh. Kalau kau—

column1: Don't!
column2: Jangan!

column1: (Mayling answered resolutely.)
column2: (Mayling menjawab tegas.)

column1: The Commander wants to push me away again when encountering danger, big meanie! I won't leave!
column2: Komandan mau menyingkirkanku lagi begitu ada bahaya, jahat! Aku tidak akan pergi!

column1: If I leave, what if everyone's Frames break! Who will maintain The Elmo!
column2: Kalau aku pergi, bagaimana kalau Frame semua orang rusak! Siapa yang merawat Elmo!

column1: Aha... I'm just thinking of your safety.
column2: Aha... aku cuma memikirkan keselamatanmu.

column1: The Doll squads and I have all struggled through real war for a long time.
column2: Aku dan regu-regu Doll sudah lama bergulat di perang sungguhan.

column1: But Mayling hasn't experienced a real, large-scale war yet.
column2: Tapi Mayling belum pernah mengalami perang besar yang sesungguhnya.

column1: (I closed my eyes. In an instant, endless burning scorched earth, shattered rubble, and ruins seemed to flash before my eyes again. The never-extinguishing smoke of gunpowder, the deafening roar of artillery, the intermittent crying... all of that still deeply lingered in my mind, as if it were yesterday.)
column2: (Kupejamkan mata. Seketika, tanah hangus yang terbakar tanpa ujung, puing-puing hancur, dan reruntuhan seakan berkelebat lagi di depan mataku. Asap mesiu yang tak pernah padam, deru artileri yang memekakkan, tangisan yang putus-putus... semuanya masih membekas dalam di benakku, seolah baru kemarin.)

column1: This battle is completely different from the previous battles with the Financial Conglomerate. I don't even know... if the current Mokosh can withstand it.
column2: Pertempuran ini benar-benar berbeda dari pertempuran sebelumnya melawan Financial Conglomerate. Aku bahkan tidak tahu... apakah Mokosh yang sekarang sanggup bertahan.

column1: So, Mayling, can you really not reconsider?
column2: Jadi, Mayling, sungguh tidak bisa kaupikirkan lagi?

column1: (Mayling shook her head resolutely.)
column2: (Mayling menggeleng tegas.)

column1: Commander, I absolutely, absolutely will not agree.
column2: Komandan, aku benar-benar, benar-benar tidak akan setuju.

column1: I am also a member of The Elmo! I want to stay here, stay by everyone's side! Whether it's helping The Elmo, helping the Doll Community or Mokosh, Commander, I want to offer my strength for everyone!
column2: Aku juga anggota Elmo! Aku mau tetap di sini, tetap di sisi semua orang! Entah membantu Elmo, membantu Doll Community atau Mokosh, Komandan, aku mau menyumbangkan tenagaku untuk semuanya!

column1: I-I have already seen everything the residents of Mokosh want to protect, and I know everything the Commander wants to protect. No matter what happens, I am not afraid. I will stay until the last moment!
column2: A-Aku sudah melihat semua yang ingin dilindungi warga Mokosh, dan aku tahu semua yang ingin dilindungi Komandan. Apa pun yang terjadi, aku tidak takut. Aku akan bertahan sampai detik terakhir!

column1: (A firm light flashed in Mayling's eyes.)
column2: (Cahaya tegas berkelebat di mata Mayling.)

column1: (I understood that, at least for a very long time in the future, I would not be able to persuade her.)
column2: (Aku paham bahwa, setidaknya untuk waktu yang sangat lama ke depan, aku tidak akan bisa membujuknya.)

column1: ...Alright. Then, during the time I'm away, The Elmo is entrusted to you, my great engineer.
column2: ...Baiklah. Kalau begitu, selama aku pergi, Elmo kutitipkan padamu, insinyur hebatku.

column1: However, you must take care of yourself. Hide if there's danger, run away if you can't win, and absolutely don't push yourself.
column2: Tapi kau harus menjaga dirimu. Sembunyi kalau ada bahaya, lari kalau tidak bisa menang, dan sama sekali jangan memaksakan diri.

column1: Mhm! I will! The Commander too!
column2: Mhm! Pasti! Komandan juga ya!

column1: Then, the combat mission arrangements are complete.
column2: Kalau begitu, penugasan misi tempur sudah lengkap.

column1: All squads, prepare immediately, set off in thirty minutes!
column2: Seluruh regu, segera bersiap, berangkat dalam tiga puluh menit!

column1: Copy that!
column2: Siap!

column1: (The Dolls left in a hurry, the figures in the command room dispersed, and the unobstructed wilderness outside the porthole appeared before my eyes again.)
column2: (Para Doll bergegas pergi, sosok-sosok di ruang komando membubarkan diri, dan padang lepas di balik jendela bundar kembali terpampang di depan mataku.)

column1: (The fierce wind was still howling, and increasingly heavy dark clouds piled up above the dome outside The Elmo.)
column2: (Angin ganas masih meraung, dan awan kelam yang kian pekat menumpuk di atas kubah luar Elmo.)

column1: (The storm... is coming.)
column2: (Badai... akan datang.)

column1: (No, for those who must reclaim the future from the vortex of war—)
column2: (Tidak, bagi mereka yang harus merebut kembali masa depan dari pusaran perang—)

column1: (The storm has already descended.)
column2: (Badai itu sudah turun.)
